items.fact: Contrastive objectives produce encoders: one embedding per input, no decoder; CLIP's image tower, SBERT, SimCSE, retrieval embedders, reranker backbones
Generative objectives need decoders: next-token (GPT) or denoising-with-generation (T5); representations optimised for next token, not geometric comparability
BERT sits in between: encoder with masked-token objective; raw embeddings poor for similarity until contrastively fine-tuned (SimCSE)
